notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the tnlandforms row (coordinates, elevation, county) and a Forest Lookouts page that gives the name and county. Elevation unit is assumed to be feet, as the record already converts it; the Amicalola row (3,390 on tnlandforms vs 3,382 ft on WillhiteWeb) supports that reading. The name Alpha is the tnlandforms author's label (GA139, above 73), so the official name is unknown. The NHLR Georgia list (29 towers) and the FFLOS list did not show Alpha in the cached copies. No build date, design, staffing, fire, or status found in two WebSearch queries and the cached pages. Suggested next step: a Georgia Forestry Commission or Fulton County source for the tower's history and whether it still stands.
